text: All package delete views reject HTTP DELETE with 405 while the validated POST protection, form, hook and transaction lifecycle remains intact.
Formset fragments authorize the target and validate root/parent/fragment ancestry before rendering; valid persisted and unsaved nested rows retain the request and {html, rows} protocol.
Core and Guardian delete previews expose only permitted protected-object labels and an independent generic blocked notice, including when every label is hidden.
Parent permission None preserves actual parent resolution and action-state enforcement; create controls/helpers and direct GET/POST agree without adding child-add requirements.

Inactive actors receive no unauthorized rows or object access through Guardian request and callable helper paths, including when authentication permits inactive sessions; active-superuser behavior is preserved.

Global fallback remains per view; the inert ViewSet flag is removed with clear diagnostics/migration; get_objects_for_user stays strict and manage shows effective policy per view and the strict helper policy.

Direct-request actor and native-template regressions preserve parent/global, aggregate purge and form/cancel contracts; changed method/access/config/context behavior is documented with paired Breaking and migration guidance.
